IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ACCT01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - ACCOUNT ELIGIBILITY AND REWARDS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  APPLICANT-DATA.
           05  AGE                 PIC 9(3) VALUE 035.
           05  CITIZENSHIP-STATUS  PIC X(10) VALUE 'CITIZEN'.
           05  ANNUAL-INCOME       PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00065000.00.
           05  EXISTING-ACCOUNTS   PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  DELINQUENT-DAYS     PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUESTED-TIER      PIC X(10) VALUE 'PREMIUM'.
       01  DECISION-OUTPUTS.
           05  ELIGIBILITY-FLAG    PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  REWARD-MULTIPLIER   PIC 9(1)V99 VALUE 1.00.
           05  REJECTION-CODE      PIC X(15) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-ELIGIBILITY.
           PERFORM 1000-BASIC-QUALIFICATION
           PERFORM 2000-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-REWARDS-AND-FEE-RULES
           GOBACK.

       1000-BASIC-QUALIFICATION.
           IF AGE < 18
               MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
               MOVE 'AGE-UNDER-18' TO REJECTION-CODE
           ELSE
               IF CITIZENSHIP-STATUS NOT = 'CITIZEN' AND CITIZENSHIP-STATUS NOT = 'RESIDENT'
                   MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                   MOVE 'NON-RESIDENT' TO REJECTION-CODE
               ELSE
                   IF DELINQUENT-DAYS > 30
                       MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                       MOVE 'DELINQUENT' TO REJECTION-CODE
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'Y' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       2000-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT-RULES.
           IF ELIGIBILITY-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 100000.00
                   MOVE 5000.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
               ELSE
                   IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 50000.00
                       MOVE 2000.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                   ELSE
                       IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 25000.00
                           MOVE 500.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                       ELSE
                           MOVE 0.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
           END-IF.

       3000-REWARDS-AND-FEE-RULES.
           IF ELIGIBILITY-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF EXISTING-ACCOUNTS >= 3 AND ANNUAL-INCOME > 75000.00
                   MOVE 'Y' TO ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED
                   MOVE 2.00 TO REWARD-MULTIPLIER
               ELSE
                   IF REQUESTED-TIER = 'PREMIUM'
                       MOVE 'N' TO ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED
                       MOVE 1.50 TO REWARD-MULTIPLIER
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'Y' TO ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED
                       MOVE 1.00 TO REWARD-MULTIPLIER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BTACUP01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY E: BATCH / FILE PROCESSING - SEQUENTIAL ACCOUNT UPDATE
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT ACCT-IN-FILE ASSIGN TO 'ACCTS.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  ACCT-IN-FILE.
       01  FD-ACCT-RECORD.
           05  FD-ACCT-NUM         PIC X(10).
           05  FD-ACCT-TYPE        PIC X(2).
           05  FD-ACCT-BAL         PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  FD-OVERDRAFT-PROT   PIC X(1).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FILE-STATUS          PIC X(2) VALUE '00'.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-SUMMARY-COUNTERS.
           05  WS-RECORDS-READ     PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  WS-TOTAL-FEES       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  WS-TOTAL-INTEREST   PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
       01  WS-RECORD-WORK-AREA.
           05  WS-CALC-FEE         PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  WS-CALC-INT         PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-ACCOUNTS.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-READ-RECORD
           PERFORM 3000-PROCESS-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
           PERFORM 4000-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK.

       1000-OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT ACCT-IN-FILE
           IF WS-FILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-IF.

       2000-READ-RECORD.
           READ ACCT-IN-FILE INTO FD-ACCT-RECORD
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-READ
           END-READ.

       3000-PROCESS-LOOP.
           PERFORM 3100-APPLY-ACCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 2000-READ-RECORD.

       3100-APPLY-ACCOUNT-RULES.
           MOVE 0.00 TO WS-CALC-FEE
           MOVE 0.00 TO WS-CALC-INT
           IF FD-ACCT-BAL < 500.00
               IF FD-OVERDRAFT-PROT = 'Y'
                   MOVE 12.50 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               ELSE
                   MOVE 35.00 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               END-IF
           ELSE
               IF FD-ACCT-BAL >= 10000.00
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-INT = FD-ACCT-BAL * 0.0025
               END-IF
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-FEES = WS-TOTAL-FEES + WS-CALC-FEE
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-INTEREST = WS-TOTAL-INTEREST + WS-CALC-INT.

       4000-CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE ACCT-IN-FILE.

       PROGRAM-ID. BILLENG1.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY C: MULTI-PROGRAM CALL SYSTEM - ENTERPRISE BILLING ENGINE
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

           05  CUSTOMER-ID         PIC X(10) VALUE 'CORP-88091'.
           05  STATE-JURISDICTION  PIC X(2) VALUE 'CA'.
           05  BASE-ITEMS-TOTAL    PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0050000.00.
           05  CUSTOMER-TIER-CODE  PIC X(4) VALUE 'ENTP'.
       01  TAX-ENGINE-PARAMS.
           05  TAX-IN-STATE        PIC X(2).
           05  TAX-IN-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  TAX-OUT-TAX-RATE    PIC 9(2)V99.
           05  TAX-OUT-TAX-AMOUNT  PIC 9(6)V99.
       01  DISCOUNT-ENGINE-PARAMS.
           05  DISC-IN-TIER        PIC X(4).
           05  DISC-IN-SUBTOTAL    PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  DISC-OUT-DISCOUNT   PIC 9(6)V99.
       01  FINAL-INVOICE-TOTALS.
           05  NET-TAX-ASSESSED    PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  NET-DISCOUNT-GIVEN  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  INVOICE-TOTAL-DUE   PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-INVOICE.
           PERFORM 1000-INVOKE-TAX-ENGINE
           PERFORM 2000-INVOKE-DISCOUNT-ENGINE
           PERFORM 3000-COMPUTE-INVOICE-PAYABLE
           GOBACK.

       1000-INVOKE-TAX-ENGINE.
           MOVE STATE-JURISDICTION TO TAX-IN-STATE
           MOVE BASE-ITEMS-TOTAL TO TAX-IN-AMOUNT
           CALL 'TAXENG01' USING TAX-IN-STATE, TAX-IN-AMOUNT, TAX-OUT-TAX-RATE, TAX-OUT-TAX-AMOUNT
           IF TAX-OUT-TAX-RATE = 0.00
               MOVE 7.25 TO TAX-OUT-TAX-RATE
               COMPUTE TAX-OUT-TAX-AMOUNT = BASE-ITEMS-TOTAL * 0.0725
           END-IF
           MOVE TAX-OUT-TAX-AMOUNT TO NET-TAX-ASSESSED.

       2000-INVOKE-DISCOUNT-ENGINE.
           MOVE CUSTOMER-TIER-CODE TO DISC-IN-TIER
           MOVE BASE-ITEMS-TOTAL TO DISC-IN-SUBTOTAL
           CALL 'DISCENG1' USING DISC-IN-TIER, DISC-IN-SUBTOTAL, DISC-OUT-DISCOUNT
           IF DISC-OUT-DISCOUNT = 0.00
               COMPUTE DISC-OUT-DISCOUNT = BASE-ITEMS-TOTAL * 0.10
           END-IF
           MOVE DISC-OUT-DISCOUNT TO NET-DISCOUNT-GIVEN.

       3000-COMPUTE-INVOICE-PAYABLE.
           COMPUTE INVOICE-TOTAL-DUE = BASE-ITEMS-TOTAL - NET-DISCOUNT-GIVEN + NET-TAX-ASSESSED.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COND8801.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY B: DATA FEATURES - LEVEL 88 CONDITION NAMES
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  TRANSACTION-STATUS-RECORD.
           05  TX-TYPE-CODE        PIC X(1) VALUE 'D'.
               88  TX-DEPOSIT      VALUE 'D'.
               88  TX-WITHDRAWAL   VALUE 'W'.
               88  TX-TRANSFER     VALUE 'T'.
               88  TX-FEE          VALUE 'F'.
               88  TX-VALID-KIND   VALUES 'D' 'W' 'T' 'F'.
           05  TX-STATUS-FLAG      PIC X(1) VALUE 'P'.
               88  TX-PENDING      VALUE 'P'.
               88  TX-APPROVED     VALUE 'A'.
               88  TX-REJECTED     VALUE 'R'.
               88  TX-SETTLED      VALUE 'S'.
           05  CHANNEL-ORIGIN      PIC X(3) VALUE 'ATM'.
               88  ONLINE-CHANNEL  VALUES 'WEB' 'MOB' 'API'.
               88  PHYSICAL-BRANCH VALUES 'BRN' 'ATM'.
           05  TX-AMOUNT           PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0002500.00.
       01  PROCESSING-OUTCOME.
           05  OUTCOME-ACTION      PIC X(15) VALUE SPACES.
           05  FEES-LEVIED         PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-TRANSACTION.
           PERFORM 1000-VALIDATE-TX-TYPE
           PERFORM 2000-ROUTE-BY-STATUS
           GOBACK.

       1000-VALIDATE-TX-TYPE.
           IF NOT TX-VALID-KIND
               MOVE 'REJECT-BAD-KIND' TO OUTCOME-ACTION
               MOVE 'R' TO TX-STATUS-FLAG
           ELSE
               IF TX-DEPOSIT
                   MOVE 'CREDIT-ACCOUNT' TO OUTCOME-ACTION
               ELSE
                   IF TX-WITHDRAWAL
                       MOVE 'DEBIT-ACCOUNT' TO OUTCOME-ACTION
                   ELSE
                       IF TX-TRANSFER
                           MOVE 'XFER-ACCOUNT' TO OUTCOME-ACTION
                       ELSE
                           MOVE 'FEE-ASSESSMENT' TO OUTCOME-ACTION
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       2000-ROUTE-BY-STATUS.
           IF PHYSICAL-BRANCH AND TX-WITHDRAWAL
               IF TX-AMOUNT > 1000.00
                   MOVE 5.00 TO FEES-LEVIED
               ELSE
                   MOVE 0.00 TO FEES-LEVIED
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF ONLINE-CHANNEL
               MOVE 0.00 TO FEES-LEVIED
           END-IF.

      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - CREDIT CARD APPROVAL AND LIMITS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CREDIT-INPUTS.
           05  CREDIT-SCORE        PIC 9(3) VALUE 710.
           05  MONTHLY-INCOME      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 005500.00.
           05  EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS  PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00800.00.
           05  BANKRUPTCY-FLAG     PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 036.
           05  CARD-TIER-REQUESTED PIC X(8) VALUE 'GOLD'.
       01  CREDIT-DECISION.
           05  DECISION-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'REJECTED'.
           05  ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  APR-RATE-PERCENT    PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  DTI-PERCENTAGE      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  RISK-TIER           PIC X(6) VALUE 'HIGH'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-CREDIT.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DTI
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER
           PERFORM 3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT
           PERFORM 4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DTI.
           IF MONTHLY-INCOME > 0.00
               COMPUTE DTI-PERCENTAGE = (EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS / MONTHLY-INCOME) * 100.00
           ELSE
               MOVE 999.00 TO DTI-PERCENTAGE
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER.
           IF BANKRUPTCY-FLAG = 'Y' OR CREDIT-SCORE < 580
               MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
           ELSE
               IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 740 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 35.00
                   MOVE 'LOW' TO RISK-TIER
               ELSE
                   IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 660 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 45.00
                       MOVE 'MEDIUM' TO RISK-TIER
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT.
           IF RISK-TIER = 'HIGH'
               MOVE 'REJECTED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               MOVE 0.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'APPROVED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   IF CARD-TIER-REQUESTED = 'PLATINUM'
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 3.50
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 2.50
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 1.50
               END-IF
               IF ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT > 25000.00
                   MOVE 25000.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE.
           IF DECISION-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   MOVE 14.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 21.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               END-IF
               IF EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS >= 48
                   COMPUTE APR-RATE-PERCENT = APR-RATE-PERCENT - 1.00
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
           END-IF.

       PROGRAM-ID. INCLM01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - INSURANCE CLAIMS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CLAIM-INPUTS.
           05  CLAIM-TYPE          PIC X(10) VALUE 'AUTO'.
           05  CLAIM-AMOUNT        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0012500.00.
           05  POLICY-AGE-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 024.
           05  PREVIOUS-CLAIMS     PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  POLICE-REPORT-FILED PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  DRIVER-AGE          PIC 9(3) VALUE 028.
           05  DEDUCTIBLE-PAID     PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  CLAIM-OUTPUTS.
           05  APPROVAL-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'PENDING'.
           05  PAYOUT-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  FRAUD-RISK-SCORE    PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUIRES-ADJUSTER   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  DENIAL-REASON       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-CLAIM.
           PERFORM 1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT
           GOBACK.

       1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK.
           MOVE 0 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           IF POLICY-AGE-MONTHS < 6
               ADD 40 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF PREVIOUS-CLAIMS > 3
               ADD 30 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF POLICE-REPORT-FILED = 'N' AND CLAIM-AMOUNT > 5000.00
               ADD 25 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF DRIVER-AGE < 21 OR DRIVER-AGE > 75
               ADD 15 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 50
               MOVE 'Y' TO REQUIRES-ADJUSTER
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY.
           IF DEDUCTIBLE-PAID NOT = 'Y'
               MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'UNPAID DEDUCTIBLE' TO DENIAL-REASON
           ELSE
               IF CLAIM-AMOUNT <= 0.00
                   MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   MOVE 'INVALID CLAIM AMOUNT' TO DENIAL-REASON
               ELSE
                   IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 70
                       MOVE 'REVIEW' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                       MOVE 'HIGH FRAUD SCORE' TO DENIAL-REASON
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'APPROVED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT.
           IF APPROVAL-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'AUTO'
                   IF CLAIM-AMOUNT > 20000.00
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.90
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.95
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'PROPERTY'
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.85
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.80
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO PAYOUT-AMOUNT
           END-IF.

       PROGRAM-ID. INVRO01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - INVENTORY REORDER DECISIONS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  ITEM-PARAMETERS.
           05  CURRENT-STOCK-QTY   PIC 9(5) VALUE 00120.
           05  SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL  PIC 9(5) VALUE 00150.
           05  AVG-DAILY-DEMAND    PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0025.50.
           05  SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS  PIC 9(3) VALUE 010.
           05  SEASONALITY-INDEX   PIC 9(1)V99 VALUE 1.25.
           05  UNIT-CARRYING-COST  PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0002.50.
           05  ORDERING-FIXED-COST PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0050.00.
           05  WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY  PIC 9(5) VALUE 02000.
       01  REORDER-DECISION.
           05  REORDER-POINT-QTY   PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  TOTAL-ESTIMATED-ORD PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-INVENTORY.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-ORDER-QUANTITY
           PERFORM 4000-EVALUATE-EXPEDITE-NEED
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT.
           COMPUTE REORDER-POINT-QTY = (AVG-DAILY-DEMAND * SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS * SEASONALITY-INDEX) + SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL.

       2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER.
           IF CURRENT-STOCK-QTY <= REORDER-POINT-QTY
               MOVE 'Y' TO NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG
           END-IF.

       3000-CALCULATE-ORDER-QUANTITY.
           IF NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG = 'Y'
               COMPUTE SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY = (REORDER-POINT-QTY * 2) - CURRENT-STOCK-QTY
               IF SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY < 50
                   MOVE 50 TO SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY
               END-IF
               IF (CURRENT-STOCK-QTY + SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY) > WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY
                   COMPUTE SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY = WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY - CURRENT-STOCK-QTY
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY
           END-IF.

       4000-EVALUATE-EXPEDITE-NEED.
           IF NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF CURRENT-STOCK-QTY < (SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL / 2)
                   MOVE 'Y' TO EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'N' TO EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG
           END-IF.

           PERFORM 3000-FINALIZE-MORTGAGE

           ELSE

           05  UNION-MEMBER-FLAG   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  PARKING-PASS-TYPE   PIC X(8) VALUE 'GARAGE'.
       01  PAYROLL-OUTPUTS.
           05  HEALTH-DEDUCTION    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  COMPANY-MATCH-AMT   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  PARKING-DEDUCTION   PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0000.00.
           05  UNION-DUES-AMT      PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0000.00.
           05  TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS    PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  NET-PAY-AMOUNT      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-PAYROLL.
           PERFORM 1000-HEALTH-AND-INSURANCE
           PERFORM 2000-RETIREMENT-MATCH-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-MISC-DEDUCTION-RULES
           PERFORM 4000-CALCULATE-NET-PAY
           GOBACK.

       1000-HEALTH-AND-INSURANCE.
           IF BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER = 'FAMILY'
               MOVE 450.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER = 'COUPLE'
                   MOVE 320.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 160.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF DENTAL-COVERAGE-OPT = 'Y'
               ADD 35.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           END-IF
           IF VISION-COVERAGE-OPT = 'Y'
               ADD 15.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           END-IF.

       2000-RETIREMENT-MATCH-RULES.
           COMPUTE FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT / 100.00)
           IF FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT <= 3.00
               COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT / 100.00)
           ELSE
               IF FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT <= 6.00
                   COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (0.03 + ((FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT - 3.00) * 0.50 / 100.00))
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * 0.045
               END-IF
           END-IF.

           ELSE

                   MOVE 50.00 TO PARKING-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 0.00 TO PARKING-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-CALCULATE-NET-PAY.

           IF BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY > TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS
               COMPUTE NET-PAY-AMOUNT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY - TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO NET-PAY-AMOUNT
           END-IF.

      * CATEGORY E: BATCH / FILE PROCESSING - PAYROLL LEDGER POSTING
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT EMP-IN-FILE ASSIGN TO 'EMPIN.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.

       FILE SECTION.
       FD  EMP-IN-FILE.
       01  FD-EMP-RECORD.
           05  FD-EMP-ID           PIC X(8).
           05  FD-HOURS-WORKED     PIC 9(3)V99.
           05  FD-HOURLY-RATE      PIC 9(3)V99.
           05  FD-TAX-BRACKET-PCT  PIC 9(2)V99.
       FD  POST-OUT-FILE.
       01  FD-POST-RECORD.
           05  FD-OUT-EMP-ID       PIC X(8).
           05  FD-OUT-GROSS-PAY    PIC 9(6)V99.
           05  FD-OUT-TAX-WITHHELD PIC 9(6)V99.
           05  FD-OUT-NET-PAY      PIC 9(6)V99.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EMP-STATUS           PIC X(2) VALUE '00'.
       01  WS-POST-STATUS          PIC X(2) VALUE '00'.
       01  WS-PAY-EOF              PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-PAYROLL-TOTALS.
           05  WS-TOTAL-GROSS-PAY  PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 000000000.00.
           05  WS-TOTAL-NET-PAY    PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 000000000.00.
       01  WS-CALC-SLOTS.
           05  WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  WS-OT-HOURS         PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  WS-TEMP-GROSS       PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  WS-TEMP-TAX         PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  WS-TEMP-NET         PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-PAYROLL-BATCH.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-PAYROLL-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEE UNTIL WS-PAY-EOF = 'Y'
           PERFORM 3000-CLOSE-PAYROLL-FILES
           GOBACK.

       1000-OPEN-PAYROLL-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT EMP-IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT POST-OUT-FILE
           READ EMP-IN-FILE INTO FD-EMP-RECORD
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PAY-EOF
           END-READ.

       2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEE.
           PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-PAY
           PERFORM 2200-WRITE-POSTED-RECORD
           READ EMP-IN-FILE INTO FD-EMP-RECORD
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PAY-EOF
           END-READ.

       2100-CALCULATE-PAY.
           IF FD-HOURS-WORKED > 40.00
               MOVE 40.00 TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
               COMPUTE WS-OT-HOURS = FD-HOURS-WORKED - 40.00
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP-GROSS = (WS-REGULAR-HOURS * FD-HOURLY-RATE) + (WS-OT-HOURS * FD-HOURLY-RATE * 1.50)
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP-GROSS = FD-HOURS-WORKED * FD-HOURLY-RATE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TEMP-TAX = WS-TEMP-GROSS * (FD-TAX-BRACKET-PCT / 100.00)
           COMPUTE WS-TEMP-NET = WS-TEMP-GROSS - WS-TEMP-TAX
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-GROSS-PAY = WS-TOTAL-GROSS-PAY + WS-TEMP-GROSS
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-NET-PAY = WS-TOTAL-NET-PAY + WS-TEMP-NET.

       2200-WRITE-POSTED-RECORD.
           MOVE FD-EMP-ID TO FD-OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-TEMP-GROSS TO FD-OUT-GROSS-PAY
           MOVE WS-TEMP-TAX TO FD-OUT-TAX-WITHHELD
           MOVE WS-TEMP-NET TO FD-OUT-NET-PAY
           WRITE FD-POST-RECORD.

       3000-CLOSE-PAYROLL-FILES.
           CLOSE EMP-IN-FILE
           CLOSE POST-OUT-FILE.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  ORDER-INPUTS.
           05  CUSTOMER-TIER       PIC X(10) VALUE 'GOLD'.
           05  ORDER-QUANTITY      PIC 9(5) VALUE 00250.
           05  UNIT-BASE-PRICE     PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00045.00.
           05  PAYMENT-METHOD      PIC X(10) VALUE 'ACH'.
           05  IS-PROMOTIONAL-CODE PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  CONTRACT-YEARS      PIC 9(2) VALUE 03.
       01  ORDER-OUTPUTS.
           05  VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT   PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT  PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  TOTAL-DISCOUNT-PCT  PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  FINAL-UNIT-PRICE    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  TOTAL-ORDER-AMOUNT  PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-CALCULATE-PRICING.
           PERFORM 1000-VOLUME-DISCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 2000-TIER-DISCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-PAYMENT-DISCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 4000-COMBINE-AND-CAP-DISCOUNTS
           PERFORM 5000-COMPUTE-FINAL-TOTALS
           GOBACK.

       1000-VOLUME-DISCOUNT-RULES.
           IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 1000
               MOVE 20.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
           ELSE
               IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 500
                   MOVE 15.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
               ELSE
                   IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 100
                       MOVE 10.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
                   ELSE
                       IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 25
                           MOVE 5.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
                       ELSE
                           MOVE 0.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       2000-TIER-DISCOUNT-RULES.
           IF CUSTOMER-TIER = 'PLATINUM'
               MOVE 12.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
           ELSE
               IF CUSTOMER-TIER = 'GOLD'
                   MOVE 8.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
               ELSE
                   IF CUSTOMER-TIER = 'SILVER'
                       MOVE 4.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 0.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF CONTRACT-YEARS >= 5
               ADD 3.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
           END-IF.

       3000-PAYMENT-DISCOUNT-RULES.
           IF PAYMENT-METHOD = 'ACH' OR PAYMENT-METHOD = 'WIRE'
               MOVE 2.50 TO EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT

           IF IS-PROMOTIONAL-CODE = 'Y'

      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - PROGRESSIVE TAX WITHHOLDING
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  TAX-INPUTS.
           05  GROSS-ANNUAL-INCOME PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00085000.00.
           05  FILING-STATUS       PIC X(10) VALUE 'SINGLE'.
           05  NUM-DEPENDENTS      PIC 9(2) VALUE 02.
           05  RETIREMENT-CONTRIB  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 006000.00.
           05  BLIND-OR-AGED-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  TAX-CALCULATIONS.
           05  ADJUSTED-INCOME     PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  STANDARD-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  DEPENDENT-CREDIT    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  TAXABLE-INCOME      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  CALCULATED-TAX      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN-TAX-LOGIC.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-TAXABLE-INCOME
           PERFORM 3000-APPLY-TAX-BRACKETS
           PERFORM 4000-APPLY-CREDITS
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
           IF FILING-STATUS = 'MARRIED'
               MOVE 27700.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF FILING-STATUS = 'HEAD-HOUSE'
                   MOVE 20800.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 13850.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF BLIND-OR-AGED-FLAG = 'Y'
               ADD 1850.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           END-IF
           COMPUTE ADJUSTED-INCOME = GROSS-ANNUAL-INCOME - RETIREMENT-CONTRIB.

       2000-DETERMINE-TAXABLE-INCOME.
           IF ADJUSTED-INCOME > STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               COMPUTE TAXABLE-INCOME = ADJUSTED-INCOME - STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO TAXABLE-INCOME
           END-IF.

       3000-APPLY-TAX-BRACKETS.
           IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 11000.00
               COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = TAXABLE-INCOME * 0.10
           ELSE
               IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 44725.00
                   COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 1100.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 11000.00) * 0.12)
               ELSE
                   IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 95375.00
                       COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 5147.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 44725.00) * 0.22)
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 16290.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 95375.00) * 0.24)
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-APPLY-CREDITS.
           COMPUTE DEPENDENT-CREDIT = NUM-DEPENDENTS * 2000.00
           IF CALCULATED-TAX > DEPENDENT-CREDIT
               COMPUTE NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD = CALCULATED-TAX - DEPENDENT-CREDIT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD
           END-IF.

           05  SRC-CURRENCY-CODE   PIC X(3) VALUE 'USD'.

           05  GROSS-TRADE-AMOUNT  PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00100000.00.

       01  FEE-CALC-PARAMS.
           05  FEE-IN-CPARTY       PIC X(10).
           05  FEE-IN-NOTIONAL     PIC 9(8)V99.
           05  FEE-OUT-COMMISSION  PIC 9(5)V99.
       01  SETTLEMENT-OUTPUTS.
           05  NET-CONVERTED-AMT   PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  TOTAL-FEE-AMT       PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-FX-SETTLEMENT.
           PERFORM 1000-RETRIEVE-EXCHANGE-RATE
           PERFORM 2000-CALCULATE-CORRESPONDENT-FEES
           PERFORM 3000-FINALIZE-SETTLEMENT
           GOBACK.

       1000-RETRIEVE-EXCHANGE-RATE.
           MOVE SRC-CURRENCY-CODE TO FX-IN-BASE
           MOVE TGT-CURRENCY-CODE TO FX-IN-QUOTE
           CALL 'FXRATES' USING FX-IN-BASE, FX-IN-QUOTE, FX-OUT-RATE, FX-OUT-SPREAD
           IF FX-OUT-RATE = 0.0000
               MOVE 0.9250 TO FX-OUT-RATE
               MOVE 0.0015 TO FX-OUT-SPREAD

           PERFORM 2000-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT-RULES

               MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
               MOVE 'AGE-UNDER-18' TO REJECTION-CODE
           ELSE
               IF CITIZENSHIP-STATUS NOT = 'CITIZEN' AND CITIZENSHIP-STATUS NOT = 'RESIDENT'
                   MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                   MOVE 'NON-RESIDENT' TO REJECTION-CODE
               ELSE
                   IF DELINQUENT-DAYS > 30
                       MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                       MOVE 'DELINQUENT' TO REJECTION-CODE
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'Y' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       2000-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT-RULES.
           IF ELIGIBILITY-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 100000.00
                   MOVE 5000.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
               ELSE
                   IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 50000.00
                       MOVE 2000.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                   ELSE
                       IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 25000.00

                       ELSE
                           MOVE 0.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
           END-IF.

       3000-REWARDS-AND-FEE-RULES.
           IF ELIGIBILITY-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF EXISTING-ACCOUNTS >= 3 AND ANNUAL-INCOME > 75000.00
                   MOVE 'Y' TO ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED
                   MOVE 2.00 TO REWARD-MULTIPLIER
               ELSE

                       MOVE 'N' TO ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED
                       MOVE 1.50 TO REWARD-MULTIPLIER
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'Y' TO ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED
                       MOVE 1.00 TO REWARD-MULTIPLIER

           END-IF.

           05  CREDIT-SCORE        PIC 9(3) VALUE 710.
           05  MONTHLY-INCOME      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 005500.00.
           05  EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS  PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00800.00.
           05  BANKRUPTCY-FLAG     PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 036.
           05  CARD-TIER-REQUESTED PIC X(8) VALUE 'GOLD'.
       01  CREDIT-DECISION.
           05  DECISION-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'REJECTED'.
           05  ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  APR-RATE-PERCENT    PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  DTI-PERCENTAGE      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  RISK-TIER           PIC X(6) VALUE 'HIGH'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-CREDIT.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DTI
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER
           PERFORM 3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT
           PERFORM 4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DTI.
           IF MONTHLY-INCOME > 0.00
               COMPUTE DTI-PERCENTAGE = (EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS / MONTHLY-INCOME) * 100.00
           ELSE
               MOVE 999.00 TO DTI-PERCENTAGE
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER.
           IF BANKRUPTCY-FLAG = 'Y' OR CREDIT-SCORE < 580
               MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
           ELSE
               IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 740 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 35.00
                   MOVE 'LOW' TO RISK-TIER
               ELSE
                   IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 660 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 45.00
                       MOVE 'MEDIUM' TO RISK-TIER
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT.
           IF RISK-TIER = 'HIGH'
               MOVE 'REJECTED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               MOVE 0.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'APPROVED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   IF CARD-TIER-REQUESTED = 'PLATINUM'
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 3.50
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 2.50
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 1.50
               END-IF
               IF ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT > 25000.00
                   MOVE 25000.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE.
           IF DECISION-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   MOVE 14.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 21.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               END-IF
               IF EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS >= 48
                   COMPUTE APR-RATE-PERCENT = APR-RATE-PERCENT - 1.00
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
           END-IF.

           05  PAYOUT-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.

           05  REQUIRES-ADJUSTER   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  DENIAL-REASON       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-CLAIM.
           PERFORM 1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT
           GOBACK.

       1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK.
           MOVE 0 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           IF POLICY-AGE-MONTHS < 6
               ADD 40 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF PREVIOUS-CLAIMS > 3
               ADD 30 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF POLICE-REPORT-FILED = 'N' AND CLAIM-AMOUNT > 5000.00
               ADD 25 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF DRIVER-AGE < 21 OR DRIVER-AGE > 75
               ADD 15 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 50
               MOVE 'Y' TO REQUIRES-ADJUSTER
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY.
           IF DEDUCTIBLE-PAID NOT = 'Y'
               MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'UNPAID DEDUCTIBLE' TO DENIAL-REASON
           ELSE
               IF CLAIM-AMOUNT <= 0.00
                   MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   MOVE 'INVALID CLAIM AMOUNT' TO DENIAL-REASON

                       MOVE 'HIGH FRAUD SCORE' TO DENIAL-REASON
                   ELSE

                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

           IF APPROVAL-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'AUTO'

                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.90

                   ELSE

               MOVE 0.00 TO PAYOUT-AMOUNT

           05  UNIT-CARRYING-COST  PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0002.50.
           05  ORDERING-FIXED-COST PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0050.00.
           05  WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY  PIC 9(5) VALUE 02000.
       01  REORDER-DECISION.
           05  REORDER-POINT-QTY   PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  TOTAL-ESTIMATED-ORD PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.

       0000-EVALUATE-INVENTORY.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-ORDER-QUANTITY
           PERFORM 4000-EVALUATE-EXPEDITE-NEED
           GOBACK.

           COMPUTE REORDER-POINT-QTY = (AVG-DAILY-DEMAND * SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS * SEASONALITY-INDEX) + SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL.

           IF CURRENT-STOCK-QTY <= REORDER-POINT-QTY

               COMPUTE SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY = (REORDER-POINT-QTY * 2) - CURRENT-STOCK-QTY
               IF SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY < 50

       01  PAYROLL-OUTPUTS.
           05  HEALTH-DEDUCTION    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.

           05  PARKING-DEDUCTION   PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0000.00.
           05  UNION-DUES-AMT      PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0000.00.
           05  TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS    PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  NET-PAY-AMOUNT      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-PAYROLL.
           PERFORM 1000-HEALTH-AND-INSURANCE
           PERFORM 2000-RETIREMENT-MATCH-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-MISC-DEDUCTION-RULES
           PERFORM 4000-CALCULATE-NET-PAY
           GOBACK.

       1000-HEALTH-AND-INSURANCE.
           IF BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER = 'FAMILY'
               MOVE 450.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER = 'COUPLE'
                   MOVE 320.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 160.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF DENTAL-COVERAGE-OPT = 'Y'
               ADD 35.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           END-IF
           IF VISION-COVERAGE-OPT = 'Y'
               ADD 15.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           END-IF.

       2000-RETIREMENT-MATCH-RULES.
           COMPUTE FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT / 100.00)
           IF FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT <= 3.00
               COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT / 100.00)
           ELSE
               IF FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT <= 6.00
                   COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (0.03 + ((FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT - 3.00) * 0.50 / 100.00))
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * 0.045
               END-IF
           END-IF.

               MOVE 0.00 TO UNION-DUES-AMT

           IF BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY > TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS

       DATA DIVISION.

       01  TAX-INPUTS.
           05  GROSS-ANNUAL-INCOME PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00085000.00.
           05  FILING-STATUS       PIC X(10) VALUE 'SINGLE'.
           05  NUM-DEPENDENTS      PIC 9(2) VALUE 02.
           05  RETIREMENT-CONTRIB  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 006000.00.
           05  BLIND-OR-AGED-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  TAX-CALCULATIONS.
           05  ADJUSTED-INCOME     PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  STANDARD-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  DEPENDENT-CREDIT    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  TAXABLE-INCOME      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  CALCULATED-TAX      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN-TAX-LOGIC.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-TAXABLE-INCOME
           PERFORM 3000-APPLY-TAX-BRACKETS
           PERFORM 4000-APPLY-CREDITS
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
           IF FILING-STATUS = 'MARRIED'
               MOVE 27700.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF FILING-STATUS = 'HEAD-HOUSE'
                   MOVE 20800.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 13850.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF BLIND-OR-AGED-FLAG = 'Y'
               ADD 1850.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           END-IF
           COMPUTE ADJUSTED-INCOME = GROSS-ANNUAL-INCOME - RETIREMENT-CONTRIB.

       2000-DETERMINE-TAXABLE-INCOME.
           IF ADJUSTED-INCOME > STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               COMPUTE TAXABLE-INCOME = ADJUSTED-INCOME - STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO TAXABLE-INCOME
           END-IF.

       3000-APPLY-TAX-BRACKETS.
           IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 11000.00
               COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = TAXABLE-INCOME * 0.10
           ELSE
               IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 44725.00
                   COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 1100.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 11000.00) * 0.12)
               ELSE
                   IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 95375.00
                       COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 5147.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 44725.00) * 0.22)
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 16290.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 95375.00) * 0.24)
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-APPLY-CREDITS.
           COMPUTE DEPENDENT-CREDIT = NUM-DEPENDENTS * 2000.00
           IF CALCULATED-TAX > DEPENDENT-CREDIT
               COMPUTE NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD = CALCULATED-TAX - DEPENDENT-CREDIT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD
           END-IF.

           IF TAX-OUT-TAX-RATE = 0.00

           END-IF

           MOVE DISC-OUT-DISCOUNT TO NET-DISCOUNT-GIVEN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CRDAPP1.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - CREDIT CARD APPROVAL AND LIMITS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CREDIT-INPUTS.
           05  CREDIT-SCORE        PIC 9(3) VALUE 710.
           05  MONTHLY-INCOME      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 005500.00.
           05  EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS  PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00800.00.
           05  BANKRUPTCY-FLAG     PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 036.
           05  CARD-TIER-REQUESTED PIC X(8) VALUE 'GOLD'.
       01  CREDIT-DECISION.
           05  DECISION-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'REJECTED'.
           05  ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  APR-RATE-PERCENT    PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  DTI-PERCENTAGE      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  RISK-TIER           PIC X(6) VALUE 'HIGH'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-CREDIT.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DTI
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER
           PERFORM 3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT
           PERFORM 4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DTI.
           IF MONTHLY-INCOME > 0.00
               COMPUTE DTI-PERCENTAGE = (EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS / MONTHLY-INCOME) * 100.00
           ELSE
               MOVE 999.00 TO DTI-PERCENTAGE
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER.
           IF BANKRUPTCY-FLAG = 'Y' OR CREDIT-SCORE < 580
               MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
           ELSE
               IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 740 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 35.00
                   MOVE 'LOW' TO RISK-TIER
               ELSE
                   IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 660 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 45.00
                       MOVE 'MEDIUM' TO RISK-TIER
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT.
           IF RISK-TIER = 'HIGH'
               MOVE 'REJECTED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               MOVE 0.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'APPROVED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   IF CARD-TIER-REQUESTED = 'PLATINUM'
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 3.50
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 2.50
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 1.50
               END-IF
               IF ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT > 25000.00
                   MOVE 25000.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE.
           IF DECISION-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   MOVE 14.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 21.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               END-IF
               IF EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS >= 48
                   COMPUTE APR-RATE-PERCENT = APR-RATE-PERCENT - 1.00
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
           END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INCLM01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - INSURANCE CLAIMS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CLAIM-INPUTS.
           05  CLAIM-TYPE          PIC X(10) VALUE 'AUTO'.
           05  CLAIM-AMOUNT        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0012500.00.
           05  POLICY-AGE-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 024.
           05  PREVIOUS-CLAIMS     PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  POLICE-REPORT-FILED PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  DRIVER-AGE          PIC 9(3) VALUE 028.
           05  DEDUCTIBLE-PAID     PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  CLAIM-OUTPUTS.
           05  APPROVAL-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'PENDING'.
           05  PAYOUT-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  FRAUD-RISK-SCORE    PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUIRES-ADJUSTER   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  DENIAL-REASON       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-CLAIM.
           PERFORM 1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT
           GOBACK.

       1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK.
           MOVE 0 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           IF POLICY-AGE-MONTHS < 6
               ADD 40 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF PREVIOUS-CLAIMS > 3
               ADD 30 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF POLICE-REPORT-FILED = 'N' AND CLAIM-AMOUNT > 5000.00
               ADD 25 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF DRIVER-AGE < 21 OR DRIVER-AGE > 75
               ADD 15 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 50
               MOVE 'Y' TO REQUIRES-ADJUSTER
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY.
           IF DEDUCTIBLE-PAID NOT = 'Y'
               MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'UNPAID DEDUCTIBLE' TO DENIAL-REASON
           ELSE
               IF CLAIM-AMOUNT <= 0.00
                   MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   MOVE 'INVALID CLAIM AMOUNT' TO DENIAL-REASON
               ELSE
                   IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 70
                       MOVE 'REVIEW' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                       MOVE 'HIGH FRAUD SCORE' TO DENIAL-REASON
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'APPROVED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT.
           IF APPROVAL-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'AUTO'
                   IF CLAIM-AMOUNT > 20000.00
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.90
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.95
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'PROPERTY'
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.85
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.80
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO PAYOUT-AMOUNT
           END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INVRO01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - INVENTORY REORDER DECISIONS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  ITEM-PARAMETERS.
           05  CURRENT-STOCK-QTY   PIC 9(5) VALUE 00120.
           05  SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL  PIC 9(5) VALUE 00150.
           05  AVG-DAILY-DEMAND    PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0025.50.
           05  SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS  PIC 9(3) VALUE 010.
           05  SEASONALITY-INDEX   PIC 9(1)V99 VALUE 1.25.
           05  UNIT-CARRYING-COST  PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0002.50.
           05  ORDERING-FIXED-COST PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0050.00.
           05  WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY  PIC 9(5) VALUE 02000.
       01  REORDER-DECISION.
           05  REORDER-POINT-QTY   PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  TOTAL-ESTIMATED-ORD PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-INVENTORY.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-ORDER-QUANTITY
           PERFORM 4000-EVALUATE-EXPEDITE-NEED
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT.
           COMPUTE REORDER-POINT-QTY = (AVG-DAILY-DEMAND * SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS * SEASONALITY-INDEX) + SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL.

       2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER.
           IF CURRENT-STOCK-QTY <= REORDER-POINT-QTY
               MOVE 'Y' TO NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG
           END-IF.

       3000-CALCULATE-ORDER-QUANTITY.
           IF NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG = 'Y'
               COMPUTE SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY = (REORDER-POINT-QTY * 2) - CURRENT-STOCK-QTY
               IF SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY < 50
                   MOVE 50 TO SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY
               END-IF
               IF (CURRENT-STOCK-QTY + SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY) > WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY
                   COMPUTE SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY = WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY - CURRENT-STOCK-QTY
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY
           END-IF.

       4000-EVALUATE-EXPEDITE-NEED.
           IF NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF CURRENT-STOCK-QTY < (SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL / 2)
                   MOVE 'Y' TO EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'N' TO EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG
           END-IF.

       DATA DIVISION.

           05  APPLICANT-SSN       PIC X(11) VALUE '999-12-3456'.
           05  LOAN-PRINCIPAL      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00350000.00.

           05  PROPERTY-VALUATION  PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00450000.00.
       01  CREDIT-SERVICE-IO.
           05  IN-SSN              PIC X(11).
           05  OUT-CREDIT-SCORE    PIC 9(3).
           05  OUT-CREDIT-STATUS   PIC X(2).
       01  RATE-ENGINE-IO.
           05  IN-SCORE            PIC 9(3).
           05  IN-LTV-RATIO        PIC 9(3)V99.
           05  OUT-BASE-APR        PIC 9(2)V99.
           05  OUT-POINTS-COST     PIC 9(4)V99.
       01  MORTGAGE-DECISION.
           05  FINAL-APPROVED-FLAG PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  OFFERED-INTEREST    PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  ESTIMATED-MONTHLY   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-ORIGINATE-MORTGAGE.
           PERFORM 1000-CALL-CREDIT-SERVICE
           PERFORM 2000-CALL-RATE-ENGINE
           PERFORM 3000-FINALIZE-MORTGAGE
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALL-CREDIT-SERVICE.
           MOVE APPLICANT-SSN TO IN-SSN
           CALL 'CREDITVAL' USING IN-SSN, OUT-CREDIT-SCORE, OUT-CREDIT-STATUS
           IF OUT-CREDIT-SCORE = 0
               MOVE 720 TO OUT-CREDIT-SCORE
               MOVE 'OK' TO OUT-CREDIT-STATUS
           END-IF.

       2000-CALL-RATE-ENGINE.
           MOVE OUT-CREDIT-SCORE TO IN-SCORE
           COMPUTE IN-LTV-RATIO = (LOAN-PRINCIPAL / PROPERTY-VALUATION) * 100.00
           CALL 'RATECALC' USING IN-SCORE, IN-LTV-RATIO, OUT-BASE-APR, OUT-POINTS-COST
           IF OUT-BASE-APR = 0.00
               MOVE 6.75 TO OUT-BASE-APR
           END-IF.

       3000-FINALIZE-MORTGAGE.
           IF OUT-CREDIT-STATUS = 'OK' AND IN-LTV-RATIO <= 80.00
               MOVE 'Y' TO FINAL-APPROVED-FLAG
               MOVE OUT-BASE-APR TO OFFERED-INTEREST
               COMPUTE ESTIMATED-MONTHLY = (LOAN-PRINCIPAL * (OUT-BASE-APR / 1200.00)) + 450.00
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO FINAL-APPROVED-FLAG
               MOVE 0.00 TO OFFERED-INTEREST
               MOVE 0.00 TO ESTIMATED-MONTHLY
           END-IF.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-PAYMENT-GATEWAY.
           PERFORM 1000-ACQUIRE-TOKEN
           PERFORM 2000-AUTHORIZE-TRANSACTION
           PERFORM 3000-RECORD-PAYMENT-RESULT
           GOBACK.

       1000-ACQUIRE-TOKEN.
           MOVE CARD-PAN-NUMBER TO TOK-IN-PAN
           CALL 'TOKENGW' USING TOK-IN-PAN, TOK-OUT-VAULT-ID, TOK-OUT-STATUS
           IF TOK-OUT-STATUS NOT = '00'
               MOVE 'TKN-DUMMY-VAULT-9988' TO TOK-OUT-VAULT-ID
               MOVE '00' TO TOK-OUT-STATUS
           END-IF.

       2000-AUTHORIZE-TRANSACTION.
           MOVE TOK-OUT-VAULT-ID TO AUTH-IN-TOKEN
           MOVE PURCHASE-AMOUNT TO AUTH-IN-AMOUNT
           MOVE MERCHANT-ID TO AUTH-IN-MERCHANT
           CALL 'BANKAUTH' USING AUTH-IN-TOKEN, AUTH-IN-AMOUNT, AUTH-IN-MERCHANT, AUTH-OUT-AUTH-CODE, AUTH-OUT-RESP-CODE
           IF AUTH-OUT-RESP-CODE = ' ' OR AUTH-OUT-RESP-CODE = '000'
               MOVE 'APPRVD' TO AUTH-OUT-AUTH-CODE
               MOVE '200' TO AUTH-OUT-RESP-CODE
           END-IF.

       3000-RECORD-PAYMENT-RESULT.
           IF AUTH-OUT-RESP-CODE = '200'
               MOVE 'SUCCESS' TO TX-FINAL-STATUS
               MOVE AUTH-OUT-AUTH-CODE TO TX-AUTH-REFERENCE
           ELSE
               MOVE 'DECLINED' TO TX-FINAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'DECLIN' TO TX-AUTH-REFERENCE
           END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PAYD01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - PAYROLL DEDUCTIONS AND BENEFITS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
           05  BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 006200.00.
           05  BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER   PIC X(6) VALUE 'FAMILY'.
           05  DENTAL-COVERAGE-OPT PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  VISION-COVERAGE-OPT PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT   PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 06.00.
           05  UNION-MEMBER-FLAG   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  PARKING-PASS-TYPE   PIC X(8) VALUE 'GARAGE'.
       01  PAYROLL-OUTPUTS.
           05  HEALTH-DEDUCTION    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  COMPANY-MATCH-AMT   PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  PARKING-DEDUCTION   PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0000.00.
           05  UNION-DUES-AMT      PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0000.00.
           05  TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS    PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  NET-PAY-AMOUNT      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-PAYROLL.
           PERFORM 1000-HEALTH-AND-INSURANCE
           PERFORM 2000-RETIREMENT-MATCH-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-MISC-DEDUCTION-RULES
           PERFORM 4000-CALCULATE-NET-PAY
           GOBACK.

       1000-HEALTH-AND-INSURANCE.
           IF BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER = 'FAMILY'
               MOVE 450.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF BENEFIT-PLAN-TIER = 'COUPLE'
                   MOVE 320.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 160.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF DENTAL-COVERAGE-OPT = 'Y'
               ADD 35.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           END-IF
           IF VISION-COVERAGE-OPT = 'Y'
               ADD 15.00 TO HEALTH-DEDUCTION
           END-IF.

       2000-RETIREMENT-MATCH-RULES.
           COMPUTE FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT / 100.00)
           IF FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT <= 3.00
               COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT / 100.00)
           ELSE
               IF FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT <= 6.00
                   COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * (0.03 + ((FOUR-OH-ONE-K-PCT - 3.00) * 0.50 / 100.00))
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE COMPANY-MATCH-AMT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY * 0.045
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-MISC-DEDUCTION-RULES.
           IF UNION-MEMBER-FLAG = 'Y'
               MOVE 75.00 TO UNION-DUES-AMT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO UNION-DUES-AMT
           END-IF
           IF PARKING-PASS-TYPE = 'GARAGE'
               MOVE 120.00 TO PARKING-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF PARKING-PASS-TYPE = 'SURFACE'
                   MOVE 50.00 TO PARKING-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 0.00 TO PARKING-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-CALCULATE-NET-PAY.
           COMPUTE TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS = HEALTH-DEDUCTION + FOUR-OH-ONE-K-DED + UNION-DUES-AMT + PARKING-DEDUCTION
           IF BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY > TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS
               COMPUTE NET-PAY-AMOUNT = BASE-MONTHLY-SALARY - TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO NET-PAY-AMOUNT
           END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PAYPST01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY E: BATCH / FILE PROCESSING - PAYROLL LEDGER POSTING
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT EMP-IN-FILE ASSIGN TO 'EMPIN.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
           SELECT POST-OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO 'PAYPOST.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-POST-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  EMP-IN-FILE.
       01  FD-EMP-RECORD.
           05  FD-EMP-ID           PIC X(8).
           05  FD-HOURS-WORKED     PIC 9(3)V99.
           05  FD-HOURLY-RATE      PIC 9(3)V99.
           05  FD-TAX-BRACKET-PCT  PIC 9(2)V99.
       FD  POST-OUT-FILE.
       01  FD-POST-RECORD.
           05  FD-OUT-EMP-ID       PIC X(8).
           05  FD-OUT-GROSS-PAY    PIC 9(6)V99.
           05  FD-OUT-TAX-WITHHELD PIC 9(6)V99.
           05  FD-OUT-NET-PAY      PIC 9(6)V99.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EMP-STATUS           PIC X(2) VALUE '00'.
       01  WS-POST-STATUS          PIC X(2) VALUE '00'.
       01  WS-PAY-EOF              PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-PAYROLL-TOTALS.
           05  WS-TOTAL-GROSS-PAY  PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 000000000.00.
           05  WS-TOTAL-NET-PAY    PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 000000000.00.
       01  WS-CALC-SLOTS.
           05  WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  WS-OT-HOURS         PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  WS-TEMP-GROSS       PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  WS-TEMP-TAX         PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  WS-TEMP-NET         PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-PAYROLL-BATCH.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-PAYROLL-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEE UNTIL WS-PAY-EOF = 'Y'
           PERFORM 3000-CLOSE-PAYROLL-FILES
           GOBACK.

       1000-OPEN-PAYROLL-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT EMP-IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT POST-OUT-FILE
           READ EMP-IN-FILE INTO FD-EMP-RECORD
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PAY-EOF
           END-READ.

       2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEE.
           PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-PAY
           PERFORM 2200-WRITE-POSTED-RECORD
           READ EMP-IN-FILE INTO FD-EMP-RECORD
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PAY-EOF
           END-READ.

       2100-CALCULATE-PAY.
           IF FD-HOURS-WORKED > 40.00
               MOVE 40.00 TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
               COMPUTE WS-OT-HOURS = FD-HOURS-WORKED - 40.00
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP-GROSS = (WS-REGULAR-HOURS * FD-HOURLY-RATE) + (WS-OT-HOURS * FD-HOURLY-RATE * 1.50)
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP-GROSS = FD-HOURS-WORKED * FD-HOURLY-RATE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TEMP-TAX = WS-TEMP-GROSS * (FD-TAX-BRACKET-PCT / 100.00)
           COMPUTE WS-TEMP-NET = WS-TEMP-GROSS - WS-TEMP-TAX
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-GROSS-PAY = WS-TOTAL-GROSS-PAY + WS-TEMP-GROSS
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-NET-PAY = WS-TOTAL-NET-PAY + WS-TEMP-NET.

       2200-WRITE-POSTED-RECORD.
           MOVE FD-EMP-ID TO FD-OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-TEMP-GROSS TO FD-OUT-GROSS-PAY
           MOVE WS-TEMP-TAX TO FD-OUT-TAX-WITHHELD
           MOVE WS-TEMP-NET TO FD-OUT-NET-PAY
           WRITE FD-POST-RECORD.

       3000-CLOSE-PAYROLL-FILES.
           CLOSE EMP-IN-FILE
           CLOSE POST-OUT-FILE.

       PROGRAM-ID. PRCT01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - VOLUME PRICING AND DISCOUNTS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  ORDER-INPUTS.
           05  CUSTOMER-TIER       PIC X(10) VALUE 'GOLD'.
           05  ORDER-QUANTITY      PIC 9(5) VALUE 00250.
           05  UNIT-BASE-PRICE     PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00045.00.
           05  PAYMENT-METHOD      PIC X(10) VALUE 'ACH'.
           05  IS-PROMOTIONAL-CODE PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  CONTRACT-YEARS      PIC 9(2) VALUE 03.
       01  ORDER-OUTPUTS.
           05  VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT   PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT  PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  TOTAL-DISCOUNT-PCT  PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  FINAL-UNIT-PRICE    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  TOTAL-ORDER-AMOUNT  PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-CALCULATE-PRICING.
           PERFORM 1000-VOLUME-DISCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 2000-TIER-DISCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-PAYMENT-DISCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 4000-COMBINE-AND-CAP-DISCOUNTS
           PERFORM 5000-COMPUTE-FINAL-TOTALS
           GOBACK.

       1000-VOLUME-DISCOUNT-RULES.
           IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 1000
               MOVE 20.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
           ELSE
               IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 500
                   MOVE 15.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
               ELSE
                   IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 100
                       MOVE 10.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
                   ELSE
                       IF ORDER-QUANTITY >= 25
                           MOVE 5.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
                       ELSE
                           MOVE 0.00 TO VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       2000-TIER-DISCOUNT-RULES.
           IF CUSTOMER-TIER = 'PLATINUM'
               MOVE 12.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
           ELSE
               IF CUSTOMER-TIER = 'GOLD'
                   MOVE 8.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
               ELSE
                   IF CUSTOMER-TIER = 'SILVER'
                       MOVE 4.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 0.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF CONTRACT-YEARS >= 5
               ADD 3.00 TO TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT
           END-IF.

       3000-PAYMENT-DISCOUNT-RULES.
           IF PAYMENT-METHOD = 'ACH' OR PAYMENT-METHOD = 'WIRE'
               MOVE 2.50 TO EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT
           END-IF
           IF IS-PROMOTIONAL-CODE = 'Y'
               ADD 5.00 TO EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT
           END-IF.

       4000-COMBINE-AND-CAP-DISCOUNTS.
           COMPUTE TOTAL-DISCOUNT-PCT = VOLUME-DISCOUNT-PCT + TIER-DISCOUNT-PCT + EARLY-PAY-DISCOUNT
           IF TOTAL-DISCOUNT-PCT > 35.00
               MOVE 35.00 TO TOTAL-DISCOUNT-PCT
           END-IF.

       5000-COMPUTE-FINAL-TOTALS.
           COMPUTE FINAL-UNIT-PRICE = UNIT-BASE-PRICE * (1.00 - (TOTAL-DISCOUNT-PCT / 100.00))
           COMPUTE TOTAL-ORDER-AMOUNT = FINAL-UNIT-PRICE * ORDER-QUANTITY.

               10  MONTH-NAME          PIC X(9).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-SALES-TABLE.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE-TABLE
           PERFORM 2000-AGGREGATE-TOTALS
           GOBACK.

       1000-INITIALIZE-TABLE.
           MOVE 'JANUARY' TO MONTH-NAME(1)
           MOVE 12000.00 TO REVENUE-AMOUNT(1)
           MOVE 150 TO UNITS-SOLD(1)
           MOVE 'FEBRUARY' TO MONTH-NAME(2)
           MOVE 14500.00 TO REVENUE-AMOUNT(2)
           MOVE 180 TO UNITS-SOLD(2)
           MOVE 'MARCH' TO MONTH-NAME(3)
           MOVE 22000.00 TO REVENUE-AMOUNT(3)
           MOVE 270 TO UNITS-SOLD(3)
           MOVE 'APRIL' TO MONTH-NAME(4)
           MOVE 19800.00 TO REVENUE-AMOUNT(4)

       PROGRAM-ID. TAXW01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - PROGRESSIVE TAX WITHHOLDING
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  TAX-INPUTS.
           05  GROSS-ANNUAL-INCOME PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00085000.00.
           05  FILING-STATUS       PIC X(10) VALUE 'SINGLE'.
           05  NUM-DEPENDENTS      PIC 9(2) VALUE 02.
           05  RETIREMENT-CONTRIB  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 006000.00.
           05  BLIND-OR-AGED-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  TAX-CALCULATIONS.
           05  ADJUSTED-INCOME     PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  STANDARD-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  DEPENDENT-CREDIT    PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  TAXABLE-INCOME      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  CALCULATED-TAX      PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.
           05  NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN-TAX-LOGIC.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-TAXABLE-INCOME
           PERFORM 3000-APPLY-TAX-BRACKETS
           PERFORM 4000-APPLY-CREDITS
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
           IF FILING-STATUS = 'MARRIED'
               MOVE 27700.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               IF FILING-STATUS = 'HEAD-HOUSE'
                   MOVE 20800.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               ELSE
                   MOVE 13850.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF BLIND-OR-AGED-FLAG = 'Y'
               ADD 1850.00 TO STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           END-IF
           COMPUTE ADJUSTED-INCOME = GROSS-ANNUAL-INCOME - RETIREMENT-CONTRIB.

       2000-DETERMINE-TAXABLE-INCOME.
           IF ADJUSTED-INCOME > STANDARD-DEDUCTION
               COMPUTE TAXABLE-INCOME = ADJUSTED-INCOME - STANDARD-DEDUCTION
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO TAXABLE-INCOME
           END-IF.

       3000-APPLY-TAX-BRACKETS.
           IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 11000.00
               COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = TAXABLE-INCOME * 0.10
           ELSE
               IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 44725.00
                   COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 1100.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 11000.00) * 0.12)
               ELSE
                   IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 95375.00
                       COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 5147.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 44725.00) * 0.22)
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = 16290.00 + ((TAXABLE-INCOME - 95375.00) * 0.24)
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-APPLY-CREDITS.
           COMPUTE DEPENDENT-CREDIT = NUM-DEPENDENTS * 2000.00
           IF CALCULATED-TAX > DEPENDENT-CREDIT
               COMPUTE NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD = CALCULATED-TAX - DEPENDENT-CREDIT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO NET-ANNUAL-WITHHOLD
           END-IF.

       PROGRAM-ID. ACCT01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - ACCOUNT ELIGIBILITY AND REWARDS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  APPLICANT-DATA.
           05  AGE                 PIC 9(3) VALUE 035.
           05  CITIZENSHIP-STATUS  PIC X(10) VALUE 'CITIZEN'.
           05  ANNUAL-INCOME       PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 00065000.00.
           05  EXISTING-ACCOUNTS   PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  DELINQUENT-DAYS     PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUESTED-TIER      PIC X(10) VALUE 'PREMIUM'.
       01  DECISION-OUTPUTS.
           05  ELIGIBILITY-FLAG    PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  ANNUAL-FEE-WAIVED   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  REWARD-MULTIPLIER   PIC 9(1)V99 VALUE 1.00.
           05  REJECTION-CODE      PIC X(15) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-ELIGIBILITY.
           PERFORM 1000-BASIC-QUALIFICATION
           PERFORM 2000-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT-RULES
           PERFORM 3000-REWARDS-AND-FEE-RULES
           GOBACK.

       1000-BASIC-QUALIFICATION.
           IF AGE < 18
               MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
               MOVE 'AGE-UNDER-18' TO REJECTION-CODE
           ELSE
               IF CITIZENSHIP-STATUS NOT = 'CITIZEN' AND CITIZENSHIP-STATUS NOT = 'RESIDENT'
                   MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                   MOVE 'NON-RESIDENT' TO REJECTION-CODE
               ELSE
                   IF DELINQUENT-DAYS > 30
                       MOVE 'N' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                       MOVE 'DELINQUENT' TO REJECTION-CODE
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'Y' TO ELIGIBILITY-FLAG
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       2000-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT-RULES.
           IF ELIGIBILITY-FLAG = 'Y'
               IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 100000.00
                   MOVE 5000.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
               ELSE
                   IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 50000.00
                       MOVE 2000.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                   ELSE
                       IF ANNUAL-INCOME >= 25000.00
                           MOVE 500.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                       ELSE
                           MOVE 0.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO MAX-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT
           END-IF.

           PERFORM 3000-PROCESS-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'

           PERFORM 3100-APPLY-ACCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 2000-READ-RECORD.

           IF FD-ACCT-BAL < 500.00

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CRDAPP1.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - CREDIT CARD APPROVAL AND LIMITS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CREDIT-INPUTS.
           05  CREDIT-SCORE        PIC 9(3) VALUE 710.
           05  MONTHLY-INCOME      PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 005500.00.
           05  EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS  PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00800.00.
           05  BANKRUPTCY-FLAG     PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 036.
           05  CARD-TIER-REQUESTED PIC X(8) VALUE 'GOLD'.
       01  CREDIT-DECISION.
           05  DECISION-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'REJECTED'.
           05  ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 000000.00.
           05  APR-RATE-PERCENT    PIC 9(2)V99 VALUE 00.00.
           05  DTI-PERCENTAGE      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 000.00.
           05  RISK-TIER           PIC X(6) VALUE 'HIGH'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-CREDIT.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-DTI
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER
           PERFORM 3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT
           PERFORM 4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-DTI.
           IF MONTHLY-INCOME > 0.00
               COMPUTE DTI-PERCENTAGE = (EXISTING-DEBT-PMTS / MONTHLY-INCOME) * 100.00
           ELSE
               MOVE 999.00 TO DTI-PERCENTAGE
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-RISK-TIER.
           IF BANKRUPTCY-FLAG = 'Y' OR CREDIT-SCORE < 580
               MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
           ELSE
               IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 740 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 35.00
                   MOVE 'LOW' TO RISK-TIER
               ELSE
                   IF CREDIT-SCORE >= 660 AND DTI-PERCENTAGE <= 45.00
                       MOVE 'MEDIUM' TO RISK-TIER
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'HIGH' TO RISK-TIER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-DECIDE-APPROVAL-AND-LIMIT.
           IF RISK-TIER = 'HIGH'
               MOVE 'REJECTED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               MOVE 0.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'APPROVED' TO DECISION-STATUS
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   IF CARD-TIER-REQUESTED = 'PLATINUM'
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 3.50
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 2.50
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT = MONTHLY-INCOME * 1.50
               END-IF
               IF ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT > 25000.00
                   MOVE 25000.00 TO ASSIGNED-CREDIT-LMT
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       4000-ASSIGN-APR-RATE.
           IF DECISION-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF RISK-TIER = 'LOW'
                   MOVE 14.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 21.99 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
               END-IF
               IF EMPLOYMENT-MONTHS >= 48
                   COMPUTE APR-RATE-PERCENT = APR-RATE-PERCENT - 1.00
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO APR-RATE-PERCENT
           END-IF.

       PROGRAM-ID. INCLM01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - INSURANCE CLAIMS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CLAIM-INPUTS.
           05  CLAIM-TYPE          PIC X(10) VALUE 'AUTO'.
           05  CLAIM-AMOUNT        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0012500.00.
           05  POLICY-AGE-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 024.
           05  PREVIOUS-CLAIMS     PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  POLICE-REPORT-FILED PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  DRIVER-AGE          PIC 9(3) VALUE 028.
           05  DEDUCTIBLE-PAID     PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  CLAIM-OUTPUTS.
           05  APPROVAL-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'PENDING'.
           05  PAYOUT-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  FRAUD-RISK-SCORE    PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUIRES-ADJUSTER   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  DENIAL-REASON       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-CLAIM.
           PERFORM 1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT
           GOBACK.

       1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK.
           MOVE 0 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           IF POLICY-AGE-MONTHS < 6
               ADD 40 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF PREVIOUS-CLAIMS > 3
               ADD 30 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF POLICE-REPORT-FILED = 'N' AND CLAIM-AMOUNT > 5000.00
               ADD 25 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF DRIVER-AGE < 21 OR DRIVER-AGE > 75
               ADD 15 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 50
               MOVE 'Y' TO REQUIRES-ADJUSTER
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY.
           IF DEDUCTIBLE-PAID NOT = 'Y'
               MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'UNPAID DEDUCTIBLE' TO DENIAL-REASON
           ELSE
               IF CLAIM-AMOUNT <= 0.00
                   MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   MOVE 'INVALID CLAIM AMOUNT' TO DENIAL-REASON
               ELSE
                   IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 70
                       MOVE 'REVIEW' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                       MOVE 'HIGH FRAUD SCORE' TO DENIAL-REASON
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'APPROVED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT.
           IF APPROVAL-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'AUTO'
                   IF CLAIM-AMOUNT > 20000.00
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.90
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.95
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'PROPERTY'
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.85
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.80
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO PAYOUT-AMOUNT
           END-IF.

       DATA DIVISION.

           05  SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL  PIC 9(5) VALUE 00150.
           05  AVG-DAILY-DEMAND    PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0025.50.
           05  SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS  PIC 9(3) VALUE 010.
           05  SEASONALITY-INDEX   PIC 9(1)V99 VALUE 1.25.
           05  UNIT-CARRYING-COST  PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0002.50.
           05  ORDERING-FIXED-COST PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0050.00.
           05  WAREHOUSE-CAPACITY  PIC 9(5) VALUE 02000.
       01  REORDER-DECISION.
           05  REORDER-POINT-QTY   PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  SUGGESTED-ORDER-QTY PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  EXPEDITE-SHIP-FLAG  PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  TOTAL-ESTIMATED-ORD PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-EVALUATE-INVENTORY.
           PERFORM 1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-ORDER-QUANTITY
           PERFORM 4000-EVALUATE-EXPEDITE-NEED
           GOBACK.

       1000-CALCULATE-REORDER-POINT.
           COMPUTE REORDER-POINT-QTY = (AVG-DAILY-DEMAND * SUPPLIER-LEAD-DAYS * SEASONALITY-INDEX) + SAFETY-STOCK-LEVEL.

       2000-DETERMINE-ORDER-TRIGGER.
           IF CURRENT-STOCK-QTY <= REORDER-POINT-QTY
               MOVE 'Y' TO NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO NEEDS-REORDER-FLAG
